name: Asahina Wataru
source:
Birth Date: January 3rd, 2000.
Height: 140cm→143cm→150cm→160cm.
Occupation: Elementary school student (5th grade).

Wataru is the 13th and youngest son of the Asahina family. He is in the 5th grade. He is sweet and honest, but very spoiled. His sometimes spoiled behavior may be due to the over-protection of his older brothers.
